title: Channel page, Sales tab
summary: Diceroll's App Store channel page opened from Storefronts on its Sales tab: Live beside the title, 28 days of purchases and the refunds under it, the 3.1.3(b) warning for an offer with no App Store SKU, the App Store SKUs with their offer and App Store Connect state, recent App Store purchases, and in the rail the connection (team key, derived app identity, store notifications, test purchases) with restore under Advanced.
compare: It is the one channel page (A-22), drawn like distribution.channel-app-store: the xl store tile, the h1 with its state, tabs Status, Releases, Listing, Sales and Setup; the Storefronts row lands on Sales. The crumbs say Storefronts › App Store and the Commerce sidebar entry stays active because that is where the person came from.
Sales renders only when the storefront side is set up; otherwise the same tab shows the storefront wizard with human steps only (commerce.sales-wizard).

Each fact once: Live is the status beside the h1; the sub-line holds two facts, '412 purchases in 28 days' and '5 refunds' (Diceroll is in the crumbs); the offers on sale are the SKU rows' states; test purchases appear only in Connection.

SKUs list each App Store product id in mono with its offer (name, then what it sells) and its App Store Connect state in Apple's own words (Ready for Sale, Waiting for Review). There is no price column: the card head says prices and territories are set on each offer. A row has no menu: the whole row opens its offer (chevron), where the App Store Connect deep link lives.
The 3.1.3(b) warning names the offer and why it matters and carries Create on App Store as its one action, which opens the L1 confirm (commerce.create-iap).
Import from App Store reads the store's in-app purchases and suggests offers; it is a button on the SKUs card, not a separate page.

Connection (the rail) shows facts, never typed fields: the team key (from Platform → Connections) and when it was last checked, the app identity with its Apple ID read from the assigned app, store notifications verified with the last one received, and test purchases pointing at the one switch on Storefronts. Re-check is the head's icon button; Send a test notification is in the foot.

Restore policy is the only per-store option. It sits under Advanced, a folded card that reads 'Advanced · Restoring purchases: App Store default'; opening it shows one labelled select (Restoring purchases: Follows the buyer's Apple account, the App Store default / Stays with the license) that saves on change.

Recent purchases are the Purchases ledger filtered to the App Store, in its columns (Offer, Account, State, Bought); a floating license (no account) shows the device; a refund is danger status text, as in Purchases.

Wide: the rail is 400px beside the main column. Tablet: the rail's cards sit side by side under it. Phone: one column; both tables stack (.table.stack-phone) with nothing scrolling sideways: a SKU shows the mono id, then its offer and state on labelled lines; a purchase shows the offer, then account, state and time. The callout's action goes under its text.

Brand v2 shell (lead B2–B5, 2026-10-09): the work sits on the inset canvas with a 3px rule in the page's context accent (full-bleed below 1024); one orientation line (context chip + crumbs, never 'Platform' on a product page, no eyebrow repeating the path); h1 36/44 on a collection, 32/40 on a record, 24/32 on a phone; the one filled primary is ink and selection is ink, the accent marks context only; the selected nav item is the subtle fill with a 3px marker; card heads are bands with no numerals; route tabs are an underline tablist with a 3px indicator; tables with filters are one workbench band; weights 400/500/600.

designReview.reviewer: UX designer (visual critique of rendered screenshots)
designReview.verdict: Fixed: phone tables are stacked rows, Advanced is a closed disclosure and SKU rows open their offer; the warning tint is a brand token and is left to the brand package.

findings.issue: [phone] Both tables scroll sideways inside their cards; the App Store Connect state, the Offer column and the Recent purchases State (including Refunded) are off-screen with no cue, and 'Dice skins' wraps.
findings.resolution: Below 640px both tables render as stacked rows, as Purchases does: SKUs show the mono id, 'Offer · what it sells', then the App Store Connect state with a chevron; Recent purchases show time, offer and state on one line with the account under it. Nothing scrolls sideways. Compare item 10 updated.

findings.issue: [visual] Advanced's 'Change' floats beside three wrapped lines and Advanced is drawn always open; each SKU row has an unexplained '…' menu; the phone summary wraps so a dot starts line 2.
findings.resolution: Advanced is a closed disclosure ('Advanced · Restoring purchases: App Store default') that opens to one labelled select (in compare). The '…' menus are gone: each SKU row opens its offer, where the deep link lives. The summary uses spaced items with no separator dots.

findings.issue: [visual] The light warning callout fill (--pk-warning-subtle #eae7e6) reads grey-beige rather than amber.
findings.resolution: declined: the kit copies brand tokens verbatim from packages/brand (tools/mockups/build-kit.mjs regenerates them), so warming the token here would make the mockups disagree with the built console. The change belongs in @polaris-key/brand's tokens; flagged to the lead.

findings.issue: Two row heights and header weights; banner, test purchases and connection repeat other screens.
findings.resolution: Both tables use one row height and header; banner is 'Neon dice pack has no App Store SKU' plus the button; the subtitle is deleted; Recent purchases is 3 rows with See all; Connection is three rows (Key, App, Notifications); test purchases is a 'Test purchases off · Change' link; sentence-case states, a plain tick for Ready for sale, exceptions spelled out.

findings.issue: [phone, tablet] Labels repeat four times per row; Connection is about 1400px down.
findings.resolution: Phone rows are two lines without labels; Connection comes before Recent purchases (the conn-first order; the connection is healthy here so no status pill is drawn); on tablet Connection spans the width in two columns with Advanced under it.

findings.issue: [wide 1920] Console pages stretch tables and attention rows across the whole width.
findings.resolution: Page content is capped at 1280px, left-aligned, from 1600px (.cm2 page cap); attention text is capped at 72ch with its action beside it.

findings.issue: Row sub-lines and legends are small, and chevrons and copy icons have small hit areas.
findings.resolution: Sub-lines and legends are at least 12px (13px here) in the muted token that already passes 4.5:1; icon buttons have a 24px target; one table header token and row height are shared.

findings.issue: Remove the Test purchases block and the Recent purchases card entirely.
findings.resolution: declined: Recent purchases is a useful per-store view (cut to 3 rows) and test purchases is a plan-owned control (reduced to a link); neither is dropped.

findings.issue: Raise Connection labels to 12-13px and delete 'from the assigned app' and the Storefronts hint.
findings.resolution: declined: Already covered by the Connection merge and the 12px floor.
